The warehouse stock list no longer shows products with quantity 0. I ran the full offline test suite and it passed. I didn't add a test for the zero-quantity case.

The change is in `DataStore.findStockLevelsByWarehouse`, in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. The query now has `AND s.quantity > 0`, which matches the other stock overviews. I also updated its Javadoc to say zero quantities are left out.

In your example, WH-1 now lists only "Bolt 10". The nuts and screws still have rows with quantity 0, and I didn't touch `findTotalStockQuantity`, so asking for the nuts in WH-1 should still answer 0. I didn't check that call path.
